resources.string: Development build. Movement estimates are not clinically validated.
Patient and therapist workflows arrive in Sprint 3.
Camera frames stay on this phone. Only consented movement summaries are saved. No images, video or landmarks are stored.

Use a stable phone support. For elbow flexion, face sideways; for shoulder abduction, face the camera. Keep the selected shoulder, elbow, wrist and hip visible. Begin in a comfortable neutral position.
Position yourself in view; reliable body tracking is unavailable.
Enter the code from your email.
Registration submitted. Enter the confirmation code from your email.
If this account exists, recovery instructions will arrive by email.
Unable to complete the request. Check your details and connection, then try again.
Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Camera analysis is unavailable. Go back and retry.
This camera is unavailable. Try the other camera.
This device cannot load the pose engine. Use an ARM phone or an emulator with ARM translation.
This account does not have access to this portal. Choose an authorized workspace.
Camera preview only. No exercise measurements are recorded.
No rehabilitation session was saved. Your therapist-prescribed exercise workflow will keep its own session records.
Sign-in tokens are protected with Android Keystore. Sign in again if the server expires or revokes your session.
Review only patients assigned to your account.
Your patient list will appear after an administrator links patients to your account.
Individual targets defined by your physical therapist.
No approved exercise catalogue is available for prescribing yet. Assignment controls will be enabled when approved protocols are available.
Review recorded sessions and valid movement measurements.
ROM trends will appear when valid measurements are available.
Follow your assigned exercise plan and review your recovery with your therapist.
Check your position with a single phone camera. No wearable sensors required.
Guided rehabilitation with camera-based movement tracking and a clearer view of your recovery.
Manage assigned patients, review their movement records and guide their rehabilitation.
Find your exercises, prepare your camera and follow your recovery journey.
Development prototype. Movement measurements require professional validation.
Position your device on a stable surface before opening the live camera.
Place the phone securely at a comfortable height.
Keep your body and the required joints in view.
Use even lighting and a clear background.
Your therapist will assign a program with your personal movement targets.
A prescribed exercise is available. Full guided-session controls are being integrated.
No exercise sessions have been recorded for this account.
Could not load your records. Check the connection and try again.

Using the cached, versioned therapist prescription.
Cycle targets: return to %1$d degrees, reach %2$d degrees
Save movement summaries on this phone. No video or landmarks are stored.
Session saved on this phone. Demo results are never uploaded.
The session action failed. Retry saving, or begin a new session if consent or assignment validity has changed.
No person detected. Position your body in view.
More than one person detected. Keep only the patient in view.
Required joints are not clearly visible. Reposition.
Keep the required joints inside the camera view.
Joint geometry is unreliable. Adjust the camera view.
Hold your position while tracking stabilizes.
Keep your trunk upright in the camera plane.
Tracking ready. Use a controlled movement.
Target reached. Return to the starting position.
Incomplete range. The target was not reached.
Movement was too brief to count.
Movement timed out. Return to the start position.
Account-isolated local records. Pending uploads are not discarded at logout.
Request failed. Check your connection, invitation details and account permissions, then retry.
Ready. Refresh to retrieve the latest server records.
Enter the email the patient uses to register. They confirm their own account and accept your code; you never need their password.
Share this code with the matching patient. It expires in seven days. Long-press to copy.
This removes your server access to this patient and deactivates your assignments. Offline copies expire within 24 hours.
Register and confirm using the invited email, then enter the code your therapist gave you.
Downloaded instructions work offline for 24 hours. Refresh online to check for changes or revoked access.
This downloaded assignment is unavailable or expired. Connect and refresh before starting.
Some assigned exercises could not be loaded. Refresh online, or ask your therapist to check the exercise and its instructions.
Tracking quality: invalid; no reliable ROM available
Supported development measurements. Publishing stores an immutable version; editing does not alter earlier session targets.
Consent to movement summaries is separate from camera permission. Withdrawal stops new collection; earlier records remain until a reviewed deletion request is completed.

Requests are recorded for administrator review. A deletion request does not silently delete data or backups. Development records have no automatic purge; retention must be configured before deployment.
Development demo; stored on this device only
Sign in again to continue upload
Server rejected this result. Refresh access and targets; a new session may be required.
Automatic retries exhausted. Check the connection and use Sync now.
Earlier result has no upload consent evidence; retained locally for review.
Waiting for upload; retries continue when connected
I consent to storing movement summaries on this phone and syncing them to my rehabilitation account. No video or landmarks are stored.
Dates use UTC and include both boundary days. Leave blank for any date.
Enter valid YYYY-MM-DD dates, with the end on or after the start.
Select a patient to review their history.
History could not be loaded. Check your connection and patient access, then retry.
%1$d sessions loaded. Charts cover these records; load older sessions for more history.
No uploaded sessions match these filters. Pending results remain in local history until synchronized.

Each chart uses one exercise version, side, prescription, metric, model and algorithm. A prescription change starts a separate chart. Limited, invalid, missing and interrupted measurements leave gaps. Charts show estimates, not clinical improvement.
No completed session with valid ROM is available for this series.
All matching history has been loaded.
Partial result: target not met, incomplete repetitions or limited measurements
Historical prescription unavailable; targets cannot be compared.
%1$s chart with %2$d valid values in %3$s. Read individual session records below for exact values.
Session order: oldest to newest. Gaps mean no comparable valid measurement.
